newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's leaves Nippon Yusen debt rating unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Moody's leaves Nippon Yusen debt rating unchanged.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Friday that it had left its Baa2 unsecured long-term debt rating for Nippon Yusen KK unchanged.
Moody's also said it had left the Baa3 debt ratings of NYK International Plc, NYK International (Netherlands) BV and NYK Finance (Cayman) Ltd unchanged.
The three companies are Nippon Yusen's overseas finance subsidiaries which are supported by keepwell agreements with Japan's top shipping company, the rating agency said.

The rating confirmation is based on Moody's belief that Nippon Yusen is well protected by various insurance and funds against possible future compensation that is likely to result from the recent tanker accident and oil spill in Tokyo Bay, it said.
